newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 7.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

The New South Wales Supreme Court is expected to hear final submissions from Advance Bank over the controversial deemed-proxy proposal it is using to approve its merger plans with St George. Justice Kim Santow on Monday questioned closely the deemed-proxy clause, suggested changes and asked Advance to make more submissions today. The clause allows Advance to vote proxies obtained from its December 23 meeting supporting the merger at a second shareholder meeting planned for next Monday.

Placer Dome Inc said Monday it was studying with interest a proposal from takeover target Highlands Gold Ltd of Australia and planned to issue a response in Australian business hours on Tuesday. Highlands offered on Monday to sell its 25 percent stake in the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea to Placer and spin off the rest of its assets into a new company.
* The Broken Hill Pty Ltd A$17.73 (-0.09)
The Australian Bureau of Meteorology on Tuesday upgraded Cyclone Rachel to category three and said it would arrive at Port Hedland in Western Australia by midday.

Australian Gold Fields N.L. (AFN) and GME Resources N.L. said on Tuesday that initial results from a soil sampling programme near Clermont in Queensland had identified three broad zones of anomalous gold. "Excellent potential for high grade gold veins exists at depth and along strike," GME and AFN said in a joint statement.
